Sign in to Instagram, TikTok and X, MP4 by default, and an export folder.

**Windows:** `Deviload-2.6.0-setup.exe`, or accept the update prompt in the app.

**Mac (test build):** accept the update prompt, or take `Deviload-2.6.0-macos-test.zip`, move it to Applications and run `xattr -cr /Applications/Deviload.app` once.

**Linux (x86_64):** `Deviload-2.6.0-amd64.deb` or `Deviload-2.6.0-x86_64.AppImage`; the AppImage updates itself.

What's new

- Sign in to Instagram, TikTok and X from Settings > Accounts, the same way as YouTube. Each link uses the session of its own site, and a task that needs an account offers the right Sign in button
- Videos are MP4 by default, with H.264 and AAC when the site has them, so they play on phones, TVs and editors. MKV and WebM are one click away next to the quality
- One export folder for Devil Cut and the converter, or keep results next to the source as before
- Saved Devil Cut projects show their clip count and the time of the last change, and no longer run off the card
- A post that needs an account no longer makes Deviload update yt-dlp or suggest the YouTube sign-in

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.5.0...v2.6.0
